Adult Core Culture · 12-Week First Term

A 12-week training rhythm for your first term.

Adult Core Culture gives new students a defined starting container with coached classes, partner guidance, practice resources, and a term review.

What the first term includes

The complete 12-week first term is $715:

  • Up to three appropriate group classes each week, with recurring class times reserved
  • Saturday Adult No-Gi inclusion
  • Uniform for first-time enrollment
  • Async Practice Vault under the current offer terms
  • Core Culture Review at the end of the term

A clear first-term path

Know what supports you from the start.

The first visit, current offer terms, partner guidance, and term review make each next step easier to understand.

1. Free First Visit

Meet Sandy, see the room, review safety, and talk through your schedule and goals.

2. Training Fit Guarantee

Eligible first-term adult offers include the 30-Day Training Fit Guarantee after at least four classes in the first 30 days (terms).

3. First-Enrollment Uniform

The first qualifying Core Culture enrollment includes one uniform under the current offer terms.

4. Partner Guidance

Placement and partner fit guide the class experience within current capacity.

First visit walkthrough

How adult beginners start

Adults begin with a 15-minute visit in normal clothes. Meet Sandy, see the room, and plan the right coached first class afterward.

Step 1

15-Minute Visit & Tour

Come in normal clothes. Meet Sandy, view the studio, and talk through your goals and weekly schedule.

Step 2

Class Recommendation

Sandy recommends an appropriate class and starting pace based on the current schedule, placement, and partner fit.

Step 3

Coached First Class

Return for the coached first class Sandy plans with you after the visit.

What adults practice

Skills for real resistance

Escape

Get out of uncomfortable positions safely.

Control

Hold positions with safe, cooperative partner control.

Adapt

Solve physical problems under pressure.

Ask questions

Get coaching while you learn.

All 12-week adult enrollments include our 30-Day Training Fit Guarantee.

For parents

Take one hour on the mats for yourself.

Many of our adult students started because their kids joined first. You spend the week managing schedules for everyone else. Take one hour on the mats to build strength, mobility, and focus in a welcoming, supportive room.
